_about: A Jev 3.3.0 app on a TypeSafe key. Recorded, not written by hand: the options are that version's own config.yaml options: defaults with the operator's values over them, as the Supervisor writes /data/options.json (the credentials are stand-ins). The data folder is the /data that version's own controller and Jev left after running its own test room (one zone, the kill switch on) with every Jev answer stubbed and no network. Every ask failed and nothing was acted on, so only state.json is there: the key alone says this box is on the Jev line.
